g.text: K5: warp specialization, one producer warpgroup and one consumer warpgroup
the producer runs ahead until all 5 slots are in flight, then blocks in producer_acquire until a release (green) frees one
each tile: consumer_wait on the full barrier, compute, consumer_release (green) which lets the producer refill that slot.
K5: setmaxnreg.dec to 24 in the producer, .inc to 240 in the consumer
What changed vs K4.2: the same consumer body, but the TMA issue loop moved to its own warpgroup, so loads are no longer interleaved with compute in one instruction stream.
